answer_text:
Here is a comprehensive breakdown of the temperatures at which food can be accepted upon delivery, based on food safety guidelines:

---

## ✅ Food Receiving (Acceptance) Temperatures

### 🥶 Cold TCS (Time/Temperature Control for Safety) Foods
- Receive cold TCS foods (such as fish) at **41°F (5°C) or lower**, unless otherwise specified.

### 🔥 Hot TCS Foods
- Receive hot TCS food at **135°F (57°C) or higher**.

### 🥚 Shell Eggs
- Receive shell eggs at an air temperature of **45°F (7°C) or lower**.

### 🥛 Milk
- Receive milk at **45°F (7°C) or lower**, then cool it to 41°F (5°C) or lower after receiving.

### 🦪 Live Shellfish (Oysters, Mussels, Clams, Scallops)
- Receive live shellfish at an air temperature of **45°F (7°C)** and an internal temperature no greater than **50°F (10°C)**.
- They should be cooled to 41°F (5°C) or below within four hours of receiving.

### 🦪 Shucked Shellfish
- Receive shucked shellfish at **45°F (7°C) or lower**.

### ❄️ Frozen Foods
- Frozen food should be **frozen solid** when received.
- Frozen TCS food should arrive at **0°F (-18°C) or colder**.
- Look for signs of thawing and refreezing, such as ice crystals in the box, fluids or water stains on the case, or frozen liquids on or in the packages.

---

## 🌡️ The Temperature Danger Zone
The danger zone is the temperature range where bacteria thrive: **41°F to 135°F**. Within this range, pathogens like Salmonella, E. coli, and Listeria multiply rapidly — bacteria can double in number every 20 minutes when food sits at these temperatures.

---

## ❌ When to Reject Food
If food temperatures do not meet requirements, or if TCS food shows evidence of previous temperature abuse, **do not accept the food**, or discard the products.

---

## 📋 Quick Reference Table

| Food Type | Acceptance Temperature |
|---|---|
| Cold TCS foods (meat, poultry, fish) | 41°F (5°C) or below |
| Hot TCS foods | 135°F (57°C) or above |
| Shell eggs | 45°F (7°C) or below |
| Milk | 45°F (7°C) or below |
| Live shellfish | Air: 45°F / Internal: 50°F or below |
| Shucked shellfish | 45°F (7°C) or below |
| Frozen foods | 0°F (-18°C) or frozen solid |

Always use a **calibrated food thermometer** when checking temperatures at receiving to ensure accuracy.
